quote: A person, except when stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted, shall not start a vehicle which is stopped, standing or parked on a highway nor enter upon a highway unless and until such movement can be made with safety.

activation.condition: a person starts a stopped, standing or parked vehicle on a highway, or enters upon a highway

obligation.description: start or enter before the movement can be made with safety
obligation.source_clause: shall not start a vehicle which is stopped, standing or parked on a highway nor enter upon a highway unless and until such movement can be made with safety.

exceptions.trigger: stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted
exceptions.effect: exception to this movement restriction; independent restrictions may still apply
exceptions.source_clause: except when stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted

timing.description: safety judgment concerns the conditions before and at the start or entry, not a later outcome alone

judgment_calls_needed.note: No legal gap, TTC or braking cutoff is supplied by the section.

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: ahead or behind in authored scenario, with original body position readback

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-grounded stopped, standing or parked purpose
